The biggest series of medleys I've ever arranged is finally complete! Now, you can enjoy them all in succession, complete with the sheet music I wrote for all the players, as well as commentary on the arrangement from me! 🎼 Sheet Music • • • http://bit.ly/31Xg22M 🎵 Watch the individual movements • • • http://bit.ly/2Ln9YLd http://bit.ly/2Ln9YLd 🎷 Subscribe • • • http://bit.ly/insanesubscribe ❤️ Support my music on Patreon • • • http://bit.ly/supportinsane 🎵 This series of medleys are unavailable for download on music distribution platforms due to a commercial usage policy existing for Berklee students recording music in Berklee Studios. No revenue is generated from this video. Now that this project has completed, it's so cool to be able to look back on it! While working on this series of videos, it felt like the most strenuous project I ever took upon myself. Looking back, it really wasn't that bad! I suppose that's how most things in life go. I'm looking forward to getting back to creating my normal videos! It's been quite a while since I recorded one, and I'm definitely feeling the itch to get creating again! If you're an ensemble looking to perform this arrangement somewhere, you have my permission to do so! I would love to see a video recording as well. You must be pretty fortunate and/or crazy to attempt playing this, kudos to you!
